verdict.rationale: Netlify documents prompting AI agents from the dashboard to fix, update, and ship code (netlify-docs-21) and connecting AI assistants to a Netlify account for deployment workflows (netlify-docs-22). An llms.txt is also live for LLM consumption (netlify-probe-1). These are one-line claims, and the dashboard agent mainly changes code rather than running Netlify operations like DNS, env vars, or rollbacks through natural language. missing for 10: detailed docs on which platform operations can be driven by natural-language commands, explicit natural-language control of site/deploy/DNS management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
